actions/*.basis: GitHub publishes the Actions platform every repository already runs on, so a non-major release adds no new trust.

github/*.basis: GitHub owns the platform these actions run on; its codeql-action publishes immutable releases.

anthropics/*.basis: Anthropic publishes the review agents every repository trusts; claude-code-action also pulls oven-sh/setup-bun (SHA-pinned) and installs bun packages and the Claude Code CLI at runtime, so this tier trusts those transitively.

reviewOnly.basis: The sync engine parses every manifest with yaml inside the credentialed sync job, so a parser change reaches every consumer.

The only root package with an install script; .github/workflows/eval-browser-dispatch.yml:153 installs the root lockfile and :251 runs its claude CLI with the AUTOMATIONS_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN secret in the step env (:203), and .github/dependabot.yml:65-66 exempts it from the cooldown, so a hijacked release reaches that secret the day it publishes.

.github/workflows/eval-browser-dispatch.yml:153 installs the root lockfile in the job that holds AUTOMATIONS_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (:203); :163 runs the playwright it pulls in, :189 runs playwright-cli, and :45 makes Bash(playwright-cli *) the eval's default tool, so it runs beside the claude process holding that secret.
